title: hieracium vogesiacum subsp. doronicoides
intro: Hieracium vogesiacum subsp. doronicoides, commonly known as Doronicoid Hawkweed, is a plant species belonging to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which are known to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. However, more research is needed to fully understand the therapeutic potential of Hieracium vogesiacum subsp. doronicoides.
